[1810](#1810)fn contract_plan_from_params(
[1811](#1811)    repo: &Path,
[1812](#1812)    store: &SqliteStore,
[1813](#1813)    params: &Value,
[1814](#1814)) -> anyhow::Result<PlanReport> {
[1815](#1815)    let task = params.get("task").and_then(Value::as_str);
[1816](#1816)    let plan = params.get("plan").filter(|value| !value.is_null());
[1817](#1817)    let plan_json = params.get("plan_json").and_then(Value::as_str);
[1818](#1818)    let selectors = task.is_some() as u8 + plan.is_some() as u8 + plan_json.is_some() as u8;
[1819](#1819)    anyhow::ensure!(
[1820](#1820)        selectors == 1,
[1821](#1821)        "create_change_contract requires exactly one of `task`, `plan`, or `plan_json`"
[1822](#1822)    );
[1823](#1823)
[1824](#1824)    if let Some(plan) = plan {
[1825](#1825)        return Ok(serde_json::from_value(plan.clone())?);
[1826](#1826)    }
[1827](#1827)    if let Some(plan_json) = plan_json {
[1828](#1828)        return Ok(serde_json::from_str(plan_json)?);
[1829](#1829)    }
[1830](#1830)
[1831](#1831)    let mut task = task.unwrap_or_default().to_string();
[1832](#1832)    if let Some(since) = params.get("since").and_then(Value::as_str) {
[1833](#1833)        task = task_with_changed_ranges(repo, &task, since)?;
[1834](#1834)    }
[1835](#1835)    let limit = limit(params);
[1836](#1836)    let memory_facts = RepoMemoryStore::open_repo(repo)?.search(&task, 8)?;
[1837](#1837)    let mut context = ContextPackBuilder::new(store as &dyn OkStore)
[1838](#1838)        .with_history_store(Some(store))
[1839](#1839)        .build(&task, limit)?;
[1840](#1840)    context.architecture_policy = configured_architecture_policy_report(repo, store)?;
[1841](#1841)    Ok(PlanEngine::new(store as &dyn OkStore)
[1842](#1842)        .with_history_store(Some(store))
[1843](#1843)        .with_memory_facts(memory_facts)
[1844](#1844)        .plan_from_context(&task, limit, context)?)
[1845](#1845)}
[1846](#1846)
[1847](#1847)fn verify_change_contract_tool(
[1848](#1848)    repo: &Path,
[1849](#1849)    store: &SqliteStore,
[1850](#1850)    params: &Value,
[1851](#1851)) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
[1852](#1852)    let contract_store = FsContractStore::new(repo.join(".ok/contracts"));
[1853](#1853)    let (contract, stored) = contract_from_params(&contract_store, params)?;
[1854](#1854)    let write_attestation = bool_arg(params, "write_attestation");
[1855](#1855)    if write_attestation && !stored {
[1856](#1856)        anyhow::bail!("write_attestation requires a stored `contract_id`");
[1857](#1857)    }
[1858](#1858)
[1859](#1859)    let mut changed_files = path_array_arg(params, "changed_files")
[1860](#1860)        .or_else(|| path_array_arg(params, "changed"))
[1861](#1861)        .unwrap_or_default();
[1862](#1862)    let mut unified_diff = params
[1863](#1863)        .get("diff")
[1864](#1864)        .and_then(Value::as_str)
[1865](#1865)        .map(str::to_string);
[1866](#1866)    if let Some(since) = params.get("since_plan").and_then(Value::as_str) {
[1867](#1867)        for change in changed_ranges_since(repo, since)? {
[1868](#1868)            if let Some(path) = change.new_path.or(change.old_path) {
[1869](#1869)                changed_files.push(path);
[1870](#1870)            }
[1871](#1871)        }
[1872](#1872)        if unified_diff.is_none() {
[1873](#1873)            unified_diff = git_diff_since(repo, since)?;
[1874](#1874)        }
[1875](#1875)    }
[1876](#1876)
[1877](#1877)    let architecture_policy = load_architecture_policy(repo)?;
[1878](#1878)    let check_dependency_delta = bool_arg(params, "check_dependency_delta")
[1879](#1879)        || bool_arg(params, "check_deps")
[1880](#1880)        || architecture_policy.is_some();
[1881](#1881)    let validation_attestations = params
[1882](#1882)        .get("validation_attestations")
[1883](#1883)        .map(|value| serde_json::from_value(value.clone()))
[1884](#1884)        .transpose()?
[1885](#1885)        .unwrap_or_default();
[1886](#1886)    let index_dir = default_index_dir(repo);
[1887](#1887)    let search_index = if TantivySearchIndex::exists(&index_dir) {
[1888](#1888)        Some(TantivySearchIndex::open_or_create(index_dir)?)
[1889](#1889)    } else {
[1890](#1890)        None
[1891](#1891)    };
[1892](#1892)
[1893](#1893)    let report = ContractVerifier::new(store as &dyn OkStore)
[1894](#1894)        .with_search_index(search_index.as_ref().map(|idx| idx as &dyn SearchIndex))
[1895](#1895)        .with_contract_store(if stored {
[1896](#1896)            Some(&contract_store as &dyn ContractStore)
[1897](#1897)        } else {
[1898](#1898)            None
[1899](#1899)        })
[1900](#1900)        .verify(
[1901](#1901)            repo,
[1902](#1902)            &contract,
[1903](#1903)            VerifyChangeInput {
[1904](#1904)                changed_files,
[1905](#1905)                unified_diff,
[1906](#1906)                evidence_refs: string_array_arg(params, "evidence_refs").unwrap_or_default(),
[1907](#1907)                run_commands: bool_arg(params, "run_commands"),
[1908](#1908)                write_attestation,
[1909](#1909)                validation_attestations,
[1910](#1910)                traceability_strict: bool_arg(params, "traceability_strict"),
[1911](#1911)                check_api_surface: bool_arg(params, "check_api_surface"),
[1912](#1912)                check_dependency_delta,
[1913](#1913)                architecture_policy,
[1914](#1914)                suppress_plan_validation_pending: false,
[1915](#1915)            },
[1916](#1916)        )?;
[1917](#1917)    format_contract_verification_output(&report, format_arg(params, "json"))
[1918](#1918)}
[1919](#1919)
[1920](#1920)fn contract_from_params(
[1921](#1921)    store: &FsContractStore,
[1922](#1922)    params: &Value,
[1923](#1923)) -> anyhow::Result<(ChangeContractV1, bool)> {
[1924](#1924)    let contract_id = params
[1925](#1925)        .get("contract_id")
[1926](#1926)        .or_else(|| params.get("id"))
[1927](#1927)        .and_then(Value::as_str);
[1928](#1928)    let contract = params.get("contract").filter(|value| !value.is_null());
[1929](#1929)    let contract_json = params.get("contract_json").and_then(Value::as_str);
[1930](#1930)    let selectors =
[1931](#1931)        contract_id.is_some() as u8 + contract.is_some() as u8 + contract_json.is_some() as u8;
[1932](#1932)    anyhow::ensure!(
[1933](#1933)        selectors == 1,
[1934](#1934)        "contract input requires exactly one of `contract_id`, `contract`, or `contract_json`"
[1935](#1935)    );
[1936](#1936)
[1937](#1937)    if let Some(id) = contract_id {
[1938](#1938)        return Ok((store.load(&ContractId::new(id))?, true));
[1939](#1939)    }
[1940](#1940)    if let Some(contract) = contract {
[1941](#1941)        return Ok((contract_from_value(contract.clone())?, false));
[1942](#1942)    }
[1943](#1943)    Ok((
[1944](#1944)        contract_from_json(contract_json.unwrap_or_default())?,
[1945](#1945)        false,
[1946](#1946)    ))
[1947](#1947)}

[2006](#2006)        api_surface_findings: report

[2009](#2009)            .map(|surface| verification_finding_summaries(&surface.findings))
[2010](#2010)            .unwrap_or_default(),
[2011](#2011)        validation_attestations: report
[2012](#2012)            .change_report
[2013](#2013)            .validation_attestations
[2014](#2014)            .iter()
[2015](#2015)            .map(|attestation| attestation.id.clone())
[2016](#2016)            .collect(),
[2017](#2017)        recommended_tests: report

[2020](#2020)            .iter()
[2021](#2021)            .map(|test| format!("{}: {}", test.name, test.reason))
[2022](#2022)            .collect(),
[2023](#2023)        evidence_refs: report.change_report.evidence_refs.clone(),
[2024](#2024)    }

[2127](#2127)    )

[2129](#2129)
[2130](#2130)fn render_contract_markdown(contract: &ChangeContractV1) -> String {
[2131](#2131)    let mut out = String::new();
[2132](#2132)    out.push_str(&format!("# Change Contract `{}`\n\n", contract.id.0));
[2133](#2133)    out.push_str(&format!("Task: {}\n\n", contract.task));
[2134](#2134)    push_markdown_list(
[2135](#2135)        &mut out,
[2136](#2136)        "Primary Files",
[2137](#2137)        &contract_files(&contract.primary_files),
[2138](#2138)    );
[2139](#2139)    push_markdown_list(
[2140](#2140)        &mut out,
[2141](#2141)        "Secondary Files",
[2142](#2142)        &contract_files(&contract.secondary_files),
[2143](#2143)    );
[2144](#2144)    push_markdown_list(
[2145](#2145)        &mut out,
[2146](#2146)        "Forbidden Files",
[2147](#2147)        &contract_files(&contract.forbidden_files),
[2148](#2148)    );
[2149](#2149)    push_markdown_list(
[2150](#2150)        &mut out,
[2151](#2151)        "Architecture Constraints",
[2152](#2152)        &contract
[2153](#2153)            .architecture_constraints
[2154](#2154)            .iter()
[2155](#2155)            .map(|constraint| {

[2157](#2157)                    "{} ({:?}): {}",
[2158](#2158)                    constraint.rule, constraint.severity, constraint.reason
[2159](#2159)                )
[2160](#2160)            })
[2161](#2161)            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
[2162](#2162)    );
[2163](#2163)    push_markdown_list(
[2164](#2164)        &mut out,
[2165](#2165)        "Validation Commands",
[2166](#2166)        &contract

[2168](#2168)            .iter()
[2169](#2169)            .map(|command| format!("{}: {}", command.command, command.reason))
[2170](#2170)            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
[2171](#2171)    );
[2172](#2172)    if let Some(quality) = contract.extensions.get("evidence_quality") {
[2173](#2173)        out.push_str("\n## Evidence Quality\n\n");
[2174](#2174)        out.push_str(&format!("```json\n{}\n```\n", quality));
[2175](#2175)    }
[2176](#2176)    out.push_str(&format!(
[2177](#2177)        "\nRisk: `{:?}` {:.2}\nConfidence: `{:?}` {:.2}\nEvidence refs: `{}`\n",

[2179](#2179)        contract.risk.score,
[2180](#2180)        contract.confidence.level,
[2181](#2181)        contract.confidence.score,
[2182](#2182)        contract.evidence_refs.len()
[2183](#2183)    ));

[2372](#2372)fn push_markdown_list(out: &mut String, title: &str, values: &[String]) {
[2373](#2373)    out.push_str(&format!("## {title}\n\n"));
[2374](#2374)    if values.is_empty() {
[2375](#2375)        out.push_str("- None\n\n");
[2376](#2376)    } else {
[2377](#2377)        for value in values {
[2378](#2378)            out.push_str(&format!("- `{value}`\n"));
[2379](#2379)        }
[2380](#2380)        out.push('\n');
[2381](#2381)    }

[2391](#2391)fn plan_from_params(params: &Value) -> anyhow::Result<PlanReport> {
[2392](#2392)    if let Some(plan) = params.get("plan") {

[2395](#2395)    if let Some(plan_json) = params.get("plan_json").and_then(Value::as_str) {

[2398](#2398)    anyhow::bail!("verify_change requires `plan` object or `plan_json` string")

[2400](#2400)
[2401](#2401)fn confidence_arg(params: &Value) -> Confidence {
[2402](#2402)    match params
[2403](#2403)        .get("confidence")
[2404](#2404)        .and_then(Value::as_str)
[2405](#2405)        .unwrap_or("medium")
[2406](#2406)        .to_ascii_lowercase()
[2407](#2407)        .as_str()
[2408](#2408)    {
[2409](#2409)        "low" => Confidence::Low,
[2410](#2410)        "high" => Confidence::High,
[2411](#2411)        "exact" => Confidence::Exact,
[2412](#2412)        _ => Confidence::Medium,
[2413](#2413)    }
[2414](#2414)}
[2415](#2415)
[2416](#2416)fn resolve_graph_node(store: &dyn MetadataStore, query: &str) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
[2417](#2417)    if query.starts_with("file:") || query.starts_with("symbol:") {
[2418](#2418)        return Ok(query.to_string());
[2419](#2419)    }
[2420](#2420)    if let Some(file) = store.get_file_by_path(Path::new(query))? {
[2421](#2421)        return Ok(format!("file:{}", file.path.display()));
[2422](#2422)    }
[2423](#2423)    if let Some(symbol) = store
[2424](#2424)        .list_symbols(Some(query), 10, 0)?
[2425](#2425)        .into_iter()
[2426](#2426)        .find(|symbol| symbol.name == query || symbol.qualified_name.ends_with(query))
[2427](#2427)    {
[2428](#2428)        return Ok(format!("symbol:{}", symbol.id.0));
[2429](#2429)    }
[2430](#2430)    Ok(query.to_string())
[2431](#2431)}
[2432](#2432)
[2433](#2433)fn resolve_history_symbol(
[2434](#2434)    store: &dyn MetadataStore,
[2435](#2435)    query: &str,
[2436](#2436)) -> anyhow::Result<open_kioku_core::Symbol> {
[2437](#2437)    if let Some(symbol) = store.symbol_by_id(&SymbolId::new(query))? {
[2438](#2438)        return Ok(symbol);
[2439](#2439)    }
[2440](#2440)    let candidates = store.list_symbols(Some(query), 101, 0)?;
[2441](#2441)    let exact = candidates
[2442](#2442)        .iter()
[2443](#2443)        .filter(|symbol| symbol.name == query || symbol.qualified_name == query)
[2444](#2444)        .cloned()
[2445](#2445)        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
[2446](#2446)    match exact.as_slice() {
[2447](#2447)        [symbol] => Ok(symbol.clone()),
[2448](#2448)        [] if candidates.len() == 1 => Ok(candidates[0].clone()),
[2449](#2449)        [] if candidates.is_empty() => anyhow::bail!("symbol not found: {query}"),
[2450](#2450)        matches => {
[2451](#2451)            let ambiguous = if matches.is_empty() {
[2452](#2452)                &candidates
[2453](#2453)            } else {
[2454](#2454)                matches
[2455](#2455)            };
[2456](#2456)            let names = ambiguous
[2457](#2457)                .iter()
[2458](#2458)                .take(10)
[2459](#2459)                .map(|symbol| format!("{} [{}]", symbol.qualified_name, symbol.id.0))
[2460](#2460)                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
[2461](#2461)                .join(", ");
[2462](#2462)            anyhow::bail!(
[2463](#2463)                "symbol query `{query}` is ambiguous; use a qualified name or symbol ID: {names}"
[2464](#2464)            )
[2465](#2465)        }
[2466](#2466)    }
[2467](#2467)}

[2489](#2489)        let config = OkConfig::default();
[2490](#2490)

[2500](#2500)            .await

[2505](#2505)    #[tokio::test]
[2506](#2506)    async fn json_rpc_protocol_edges_are_stable() {
[2507](#2507)        let store = SqliteStore::open(":memory:").unwrap();
[2508](#2508)        let config = OkConfig::default();
[2509](#2509)
[2510](#2510)        let string_id = handle_line(
[2511](#2511)            Path::new("."),
[2512](#2512)            &store,
[2513](#2513)            &config,
[2514](#2514)            r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"req-1","method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2024-11-05"}}"#,
[2515](#2515)        )
[2516](#2516)        .await;
[2517](#2517)        assert_eq!(string_id.id, Some(json!("req-1")));
[2518](#2518)        assert_eq!(string_id.result.unwrap()["protocolVersion"], "2024-11-05");
[2519](#2519)
[2520](#2520)        let numeric_id = handle_line(
[2521](#2521)            Path::new("."),
[2522](#2522)            &store,
[2523](#2523)            &config,
[2524](#2524)            r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":7,"method":"initialize","params":{}}"#,
[2525](#2525)        )
[2526](#2526)        .await;
[2527](#2527)        assert_eq!(numeric_id.id, Some(json!(7)));
[2528](#2528)        assert!(numeric_id.error.is_none());
[2529](#2529)
[2530](#2530)        let missing_method = handle_line(
[2531](#2531)            Path::new("."),
[2532](#2532)            &store,
[2533](#2533)            &config,
[2534](#2534)            r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"missing-method","params":{}}"#,
[2535](#2535)        )
[2536](#2536)        .await;
[2537](#2537)        assert_eq!(missing_method.id, Some(json!("missing-method")));
[2538](#2538)        assert_eq!(missing_method.error.unwrap()["code"], -32600);
[2539](#2539)
[2540](#2540)        let malformed = handle_line(Path::new("."), &store, &config, "{").await;
[2541](#2541)        assert_eq!(malformed.id, None);
[2542](#2542)        assert_eq!(malformed.error.unwrap()["code"], -32700);
[2543](#2543)
[2544](#2544)        let malformed_unicode = handle_line(
[2545](#2545)            Path::new("."),
[2546](#2546)            &store,
[2547](#2547)            &config,
[2548](#2548)            r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"bad-unicode","method":"initialize","params":{"client":"\uD800"}}"#,
[2549](#2549)        )
[2550](#2550)        .await;
[2551](#2551)        assert_eq!(malformed_unicode.id, None);
[2552](#2552)        assert_eq!(malformed_unicode.error.unwrap()["code"], -32700);
[2553](#2553)
[2554](#2554)        let unknown_method = handle_line(
[2555](#2555)            Path::new("."),
[2556](#2556)            &store,
[2557](#2557)            &config,
[2558](#2558)            r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"unknown-method","method":"missing_method","params":{}}"#,
[2559](#2559)        )
[2560](#2560)        .await;
[2561](#2561)        assert_eq!(unknown_method.id, Some(json!("unknown-method")));
[2562](#2562)        assert_eq!(unknown_method.error.unwrap()["code"], -32000);
[2563](#2563)
[2564](#2564)        let tool_error = handle_line(
[2565](#2565)            Path::new("."),
[2566](#2566)            &store,
[2567](#2567)            &config,
[2568](#2568)            r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"tool-error","method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"missing_tool","arguments":{}}}"#,
[2569](#2569)        )
[2570](#2570)        .await;
[2571](#2571)        assert_eq!(tool_error.id, Some(json!("tool-error")));
[2572](#2572)        let error = tool_error.error.unwrap();
[2573](#2573)        assert_eq!(error["code"], -32000);
[2574](#2574)        assert!(error["message"]
[2575](#2575)            .as_str()
[2576](#2576)            .unwrap()
[2577](#2577)            .contains("unknown MCP method or tool"));
[2578](#2578)    }

[2604](#2604)    #[tokio::test]

[2818](#2818)    fn unique_snapshot_repo() -> PathBuf {

[2820](#2820)            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
[2821](#2821)            .unwrap_or_default()
[2822](#2822)            .as_nanos();
[2823](#2823)        let repo = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
[2824](#2824)            "open-kioku-mcp-snapshots-{}-{now}",
[2825](#2825)            std::process::id()
[2826](#2826)        ));
[2827](#2827)        fs::create_dir_all(&repo).unwrap();
[2828](#2828)        repo
[2829](#2829)    }

[2852](#2852)    fn assert_mcp_snapshot(name: &str, response: &JsonRpcResponse) {
[2853](#2853)        let mut value = serde_json::to_value(response).unwrap();
[2854](#2854)        normalize_mcp_snapshot(&mut value);
[2855](#2855)        let formatted = format!("{}\n", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&value).unwrap());
[2856](#2856)        let snapshot_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("snapshots/mcp");
[2857](#2857)        fs::create_dir_all(&snapshot_dir).unwrap();
[2858](#2858)        let snapshot_file = snapshot_dir.join(name);
[2859](#2859)        if snapshot_file.exists() {
[2860](#2860)            let expected = fs::read_to_string(&snapshot_file).unwrap();
[2861](#2861)            assert_eq!(
[2862](#2862)                expected.trim(),
[2863](#2863)                formatted.trim(),
[2864](#2864)                "MCP snapshot mismatch: {}",
[2865](#2865)                snapshot_file.display()
[2866](#2866)            );
[2867](#2867)        } else {
[2868](#2868)            fs::write(snapshot_file, formatted).unwrap();
[2869](#2869)        }
[2870](#2870)    }
[2871](#2871)
[2872](#2872)    fn normalize_mcp_snapshot(value: &mut Value) {
[2873](#2873)        match value {
[2874](#2874)            Value::Object(map) => {
[2875](#2875)                for (key, value) in map.iter_mut() {
[2876](#2876)                    if key == "expires_at" {
[2877](#2877)                        *value = json!("<expires_at>");
[2878](#2878)                    } else if key == "freshness" {
[2879](#2879)                        *value = json!("<freshness>");
[2880](#2880)                    } else if matches!(
[2881](#2881)                        key.as_str(),
[2882](#2882)                        "score"
[2883](#2883)                            | "confidence"
[2884](#2884)                            | "raw_value"
[2885](#2885)                            | "normalized_value"
[2886](#2886)                            | "weight"
[2887](#2887)                            | "contribution"
[2888](#2888)                    ) && value.is_number()
[2889](#2889)                    {
[2890](#2890)                        *value = json!("<score>");
[2891](#2891)                    } else {
[2892](#2892)                        normalize_mcp_snapshot(value);
[2893](#2893)                    }
[2894](#2894)                }
[2895](#2895)            }
[2896](#2896)            Value::Array(values) => {
[2897](#2897)                for value in values {
[2898](#2898)                    normalize_mcp_snapshot(value);
[2899](#2899)                }
[2900](#2900)            }
[2901](#2901)            _ => {}
[2902](#2902)        }
[2903](#2903)    }

[2906](#2906)    async fn query_evidence_graph_returns_metadata_and_continuation() {
[2907](#2907)        let store = SqliteStore::open(":memory:").unwrap();
[2908](#2908)        let config = OkConfig::default();
[2909](#2909)        let root = GraphNode {
[2910](#2910)            id: NodeId::new("file:root"),
[2911](#2911)            node_type: GraphNodeType::File,
[2912](#2912)            label: "root".into(),
[2913](#2913)            ..Default::default()
[2914](#2914)        };
[2915](#2915)        let mut nodes = vec![root.clone()];
[2916](#2916)        let mut edges = Vec::new();
[2917](#2917)        for idx in 0..3 {
[2918](#2918)            let node = GraphNode {
[2919](#2919)                id: NodeId::new(format!("symbol:fn{idx}")),
[2920](#2920)                node_type: GraphNodeType::Function,
[2921](#2921)                label: format!("fn{idx}"),
[2922](#2922)                ..Default::default()
[2923](#2923)            };
[2924](#2924)            edges.push(GraphEdge {
[2925](#2925)                id: EdgeId::new(format!("edge:{idx}")),
[2926](#2926)                from: root.id.clone(),
[2927](#2927)                to: node.id.clone(),
[2928](#2928)                edge_type: GraphEdgeType::Defines,
[2929](#2929)                ..Default::default()
[2930](#2930)            });
[2931](#2931)            nodes.push(node);
[2932](#2932)        }
[2933](#2933)        store.replace_graph(&nodes, &edges).unwrap();
[2934](#2934)
[2935](#2935)        let result = dispatch(
[2936](#2936)            Path::new("."),
[2937](#2937)            &store,
[2938](#2938)            &config,
[2939](#2939)            "query_evidence_graph",
[2940](#2940)            json!({
[2941](#2941)                "query": "MATCH (f:File)-[:DEFINES]->(s:Function) RETURN f, s LIMIT 2"
[2942](#2942)            }),
[2943](#2943)        )
[2944](#2944)        .await
[2945](#2945)        .unwrap();
[2946](#2946)
[2947](#2947)        assert_eq!(result["returned"], 2);
[2948](#2948)        assert_eq!(result["limit"], 2);
[2949](#2949)        assert_eq!(result["offset"], 0);
[2950](#2950)        assert_eq!(result["has_more"], true);
[2951](#2951)        assert_eq!(result["truncated"], false);
[2952](#2952)        assert!(result["continuation"].as_str().unwrap().starts_with("okc_"));
[2953](#2953)        assert_eq!(result["next"]["arguments"]["offset"], 2);
[2954](#2954)    }

[2985](#2985)    async fn test_tools_list_respects_security_config() {
[2986](#2986)        let store = SqliteStore::open(":memory:").unwrap();
[2987](#2987)
[2988](#2988)        let mut config_read_only = OkConfig::default();
[2989](#2989)        config_read_only.security.allow_write = false;
[2990](#2990)

[2992](#2992)        let result_ro = dispatch(
[2993](#2993)            Path::new("."),
[2994](#2994)            &store,
[2995](#2995)            &config_read_only,
[2996](#2996)            "tools/list",
[2997](#2997)            params.clone(),
[2998](#2998)        )
[2999](#2999)        .await
[3000](#3000)        .unwrap();
[3001](#3001)        let tools_ro = result_ro["tools"].as_array().unwrap();
[3002](#3002)        assert!(tools_ro.iter().all(|t| t["name"] != "apply_patch"));
[3003](#3003)        for tool in tools_ro {

[3006](#3006)            let description = tool["description"].as_str().unwrap_or_default();
[3007](#3007)            assert!(
[3008](#3008)                title.starts_with("Open Kioku ") && title.len() > name.len(),
[3009](#3009)                "{name} should expose a meaningful MCP title"
[3010](#3010)            );
[3011](#3011)            assert!(
[3012](#3012)                description.contains("Use ") && description.len() >= 160,
[3013](#3013)                "{name} should include TDQS usage guidance"
[3014](#3014)            );
[3015](#3015)            assert!(
[3016](#3016)                tool["inputSchema"].is_object(),
[3017](#3017)                "{name} should expose an input schema"
[3018](#3018)            );
[3019](#3019)            assert!(
[3020](#3020)                tool["outputSchema"].is_object(),
[3021](#3021)                "{name} should expose an output schema"
[3022](#3022)            );
[3023](#3023)            assert!(
[3024](#3024)                tool["annotations"]["readOnlyHint"].is_boolean(),
[3025](#3025)                "{name} should expose MCP annotations"
[3026](#3026)            );
[3027](#3027)            assert!(
[3028](#3028)                tool["annotations"]["destructiveHint"].is_boolean(),
[3029](#3029)                "{name} should expose destructiveHint"
[3030](#3030)            );
[3031](#3031)            assert!(
[3032](#3032)                tool["annotations"]["idempotentHint"].is_boolean(),
[3033](#3033)                "{name} should expose idempotentHint"
[3034](#3034)            );
[3035](#3035)            assert!(
[3036](#3036)                tool["annotations"]["openWorldHint"].is_boolean(),
[3037](#3037)                "{name} should expose openWorldHint"
[3038](#3038)            );
[3039](#3039)        }
[3040](#3040)        let provenance = tools_ro
[3041](#3041)            .iter()
[3042](#3042)            .find(|tool| tool["name"] == "history_provenance_lookup")
[3043](#3043)            .unwrap();
[3044](#3044)        assert_eq!(provenance["maturity"], "experimental");
[3045](#3045)        let churn = tools_ro
